title: A Broke Man Declared Himself Emperor. The City Played Along 👑
caption:
A broke man declared himself Emperor of the USA 👑
Wait for the ending 👀

True story. In 1859 Joshua Norton, who had lost his fortune, declared himself Emperor of the United States in a San Francisco newspaper. He issued his own money, which some local businesses accepted, and thousands came to his funeral.
Would you have accepted his money? 👇
first_comment: Lost all his money, so he printed his own. And shops ACCEPTED it. Legend or scam? 👑👇
